Instance.Rule: a job runs on the first instance of Instances whose MemoryFitFraction x MemoryGiB holds the job's largest estimated Palace peak (the stage estimates' GB / the cost model's PalaceGBPerGiB): m8g.48xlarge (768 GiB, 192 Graviton4 vCPUs) is the default, r8g.48xlarge (1,536 GiB) the fallback for an estimated peak above 0.6 x 768 = 460.8 GiB (the device library's largest estimate is 338 GB, 7f03's p5 control; measured node peaks <= ~240 GiB; the streaming reducer ~34 GB); c8g.48xlarge (384 GiB) is deliberately absent - not safe for the p5 control stages of the largest coupons (USER decision 2026-09-22). The plan records the chosen instance (Instance) and its admission guard MinimumMemAvailableBytes = MemoryFitFraction x MemoryGiB, checked by run_stages before the first stage; the job script's #PBS -l instance_type is the chosen type
